preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
For each test case, the length of the permutation n must be between 2 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically smallest good permutation p of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(p[i] != i + 1 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The permutation p must be good, meaning no element at index i is equal to i + 1.
